"Ex ovo omnia."
(Everything comes from the egg.)

entries.title: Book I: The Organs of Generation
entries.content: The focus turns to the origins of life. The male and female reproductive systems are set out in structure: the uterus as a single organ, the testes and their vessels traced, the anatomy of the penis described with clarity.

entries.title: Book I: The Organs of Generation
entries.content: Yet this account is uneven. His descriptions of female anatomy contain notable inaccuracies—reflecting limited access to female bodies, and the social and cultural limits of his time.

entries.title: Book I: The Organs of Generation
entries.content: What is shown shapes what is known.
